import re

def parse_suggestion_lines(content):
    # content contains multiple lines; extract add/remove lines of format
    # add => Title by Artist1, Artist2
    adds=[]; removes=[]
    for line in content.splitlines():
        line=line.strip()
        if line.startswith('add => '):
            rest=line[len('add => '):]
            if ' by ' in rest:
                title, artists_str = rest.split(' by ',1)
                artists=[a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
                adds.append({'title':title.strip(), 'artists':artists})
        elif line.startswith('remove => '):
            rest=line[len('remove => '):]
            if ' by ' in rest:
                title, artists_str = rest.split(' by ',1)
                artists=[a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
                removes.append({'title':title.strip(), 'artists':artists})
    return adds, removes

# parse only suggestion blocks: content starts with 'I have a few suggestions.'

def extract_add_remove(comments):
    adds=[]; removes=[]; playlist_url=None
    for c in comments:
        if c['content'].startswith('I have created this playlist'):
            # extract playlist id
            m=re.search(r'/playlists/(\d+)', c['content'])
            if m:
                playlist_url=int(m.group(1))
        if c['content'].strip()=='I have a few suggestions.':
            # no add/remove lines
            continue
        if c['content'].startswith('I have a few suggestions.'):
            # parse add/remove lines within this comment
            a,r=parse_suggestion_lines(c['content'])
            adds.extend(a); removes.extend(r)
    return playlist_url, adds, removes
